basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Physical AI Domain Expert · GTM Builder · Founder · MBA
basics.summary: Rare combination of authentic Physical AI domain depth and commercial AI-shipping track record. Built Robogen at EPFL (open-source platform for co-evolution of robot bodies and brains via genetic algorithms, scaled to AWS for parallel simulation, taught the subject to 20+ master's students). Founding engineer at Dronistics where 500+ autonomous deliveries powered partnerships with Unilever and a CES showcase. Built production AI agents at LumApps that generated a forecast $4M/quarter pipeline, founded three companies, and speak fluently with VC-backed founders and CTOs. MBA-trained on turning technical wins into repeatable commercial motions.

work.name: LumApps
work.summary: Built production AI agents that generate qualified pipeline at scale. Owns AI transformation strategy end-to-end and reports to C-level on outcomes.
highlights: Built and deployed production AI agents for outbound pipeline generation. 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities; forecast $4M in approved opportunities per quarter at 25% conversion. Personal proof of how AI moves pipeline metrics.
Owns company-wide AI transformation strategy, governance, and sales enablement. Translates frontier AI capability into category-defining commercial motion.
Built AI Brain, the intelligent context layer unifying conversation data, usage analytics, and notes; surfaces deal patterns that inform sales playbooks across product, sales, and CS.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
work.summary: Technical lead who co-owned GTM launches with Product and Sales. Built AI into the revenue motion and partnered cross-functionally to turn technical wins into repeatable plays.
highlights: Co-owned GTM launches with Product and Sales (Seasonal Templates, Re-ignite Revenue, Employee Referral, Sentiment Analysis). Codified what worked into reusable launch playbooks; each shipped with instrumentation so the bet was proven or killed within a week.
Built GenAI demo system for Sales: auto-generates personalized content from Salesforce data so every pitch feels custom-built for that customer. Improved demo speed and close rates.
Architected Employee Referral System end-to-end. Became the platform's top revenue channel ($1.5M+ generated, $500K ARR). Designed for 99.99% SLA because customer trust is measured in uptime.
Replaced $337K in annual vendor translation contract with an in-house LLM pipeline in 6 weeks. Direct vendor spend control and proof of compute-cost ROI reasoning.

work.name: Tenity

highlights: Evaluated 20+ venture-backed startups on technical architecture, scalability, and AI readiness. Same lens used to engage founder and CTO buyers.
Mentored portfolio companies including Opt Alpha on scaling AI and infrastructure systems in production. Speak the language of the builders, not just the buyer.

work.name: Dronistics
work.summary: Founding engineer at an EPFL spin-off building autonomous drone delivery: cloud infrastructure, real-time control, and partnerships with enterprise customers.
highlights: Shipped end-to-end autonomous drone delivery platform (real-time control APIs, cloud, optimization). 500+ live deliveries, 40% faster deliveries, 99.5% safety record, zero incidents. Hands-on with autonomous systems running in the real world.
Built cloud infrastructure and CI/CD pipeline from scratch. Enterprise-grade reliability that secured partnerships with Unilever and a CES Las Vegas showcase.

work.name: EPFL, Laboratory of Intelligent Systems (Robogen)
work.summary: Research engineer on Robogen, an open-source platform for co-evolution of robot morphologies and control systems. Deep credibility on robotics, simulation, embodied AI.
highlights: Engineered Robogen, an open-source platform where robot bodies and brains co-evolve via genetic algorithms. Rare research direction at the intersection of morphology, neural control, and simulation. Directly relevant to Physical AI and embodied intelligence.

Migrated the simulation pipeline to AWS for large-scale parallel evolution runs impractical on local hardware. Secured AWS Cloud Credits for Research; work featured on the AWS Public Sector Blog. First-hand experience of compute-intensive simulation workloads on cloud GPU.

Teaching Assistant for Evolutionary Robotics at EPFL. Supervised 20+ master's students through hands-on projects in genetic algorithms, neural controllers, and embodied AI. Comfortable teaching the builders.

_jobApplication.jobDescription: Sales overlay / domain-specialist role driving repeatable revenue for Nebius' Physical AI segment (robotics, autonomous systems, simulation, embodied intelligence). Owns Top 25 target list, partners with AEs and Field CTO on deal acceleration, builds Physical AI playbook, enables field team. Targets Foundation Model builders, Humanoid robotics, autonomous systems, simulation-first startups. Requires 7+ years sales overlay / GTM strategy / domain-specialist selling in Cloud, AI Infra, or HPC. Remote US (SF Bay or Austin preferred). $254k-$266k OTE + equity.
_jobApplication.notes: Honest stretch. Candidate is engineer/founder, not a quota-carrying sales overlay. Unique angle: authentic Physical AI domain depth (EPFL Robogen robot co-evolution + AWS-scale simulation + taught Evolutionary Robotics + Dronistics autonomous delivery founding engineer) that almost no career-sales candidate will match. Plus commercial proof (AI outbound agents generating $4M/quarter pipeline forecast at LumApps, $1.5M+ revenue channel architected at Beekeeper, 3 founded companies). MBA + builder + founder = credibility with VC-backed CTOs the JD names. Gaps to address upfront in cover: (1) no formal sales quota or AE partnership track record at GTM-Director scale, (2) US-based role, candidate in Zurich (relocation possible). The pitch is: technical founder-operator pivoting into the domain-specialist seat where deep robotics fluency + AI-shipping track record + builder credibility outweigh missing sales-overlay reps. Best fit if the hiring manager prioritises Physical AI authenticity and customer trust over classic sales playbook execution.
